intro: Siri set expectations for voice assistants and then stayed there. Timers, calls, weather, quick questions: instant and reliable. Anything with more than one step: not its job. Your workday is almost entirely multi-step. Emails that need replies, meetings that need prep, tasks scattered across four tools. GAIA was built for that layer. It connects to your tools, remembers your patterns, and does the follow-through Siri was never designed to attempt.
